note: Rejudged 2026-10-24 by an independent auditor (authored none of it). RFC 4271 Section 5.1.2 b), rfc/full/rfc4271.txt:1393-1425: "When a given BGP speaker advertises the route to an external peer, the advertising speaker updates the AS_PATH attribute as follows:" followed by 1) prepend into a leading AS_SEQUENCE, with a new AS_SEQUENCE on overflow, 2) a new AS_SEQUENCE before a leading AS_SET, 3) creating an AS_SEQUENCE when the AS_PATH is empty. STALE only because 850913e128 (owner-approved, RFC-approved line in its body) rewrote assertions 1 and 2 of checkRelayWithdrawalShape from a two-step loop calling fail(index+1, err) into two literal runOperation calls with fail(1, ...) and fail(2, ...): the same operations (FRR session to zeAddress, then the relayed route with a 60 s timeout), in the same order, with the same failure numbers. Read the whole function: assertion 3 still reads the route back from FRR and requires the exact relayed AS_PATH (requireFRRASPath against zeInjectorASPath), assertions 4 and 5 still require FRR to drop the prefix and log its own decode of the withdrawal, and assertion 6 is the negative half. No behaviour changed, so the 2026-10-08 whole-row judgement stands for every other carrier (TestEstablishedAnnounce_ExplicitASPath_PrependsLocalAS/IBGPVerbatim, both TestASPathSlotPrependOnlyWhenAdvertising covers, TestASPathSlotPrependsBeforeALeadingASSet, TestASPathSlotStartsANewSegmentWhenTheLeadingOneIsFull, TestForwardPresentEmptyASPath), with its stated limits: the overflow retained-member check is count-only and the iBGP control compares decoded numbers, not TLV bytes. The interop pair is recorded with a paired break in 20016b8e32; no fresh interop run is claimed here. rfc4271_reactor_batch_test.go carries another session's uncommitted NewINET hunks at lines 203-384, outside both tagged units (543+), so the tagged unit shas are those of HEAD.
